name: Dorsten (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of green and white, charged at the top with the city arms of Dorsten (a key and a black cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Dorsten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Dorsten arms — key and cross on white
